name: TILLY
bio: The anxious AI of the colony ship Ark Meridian in SEEDFALL. 365 days until forty thousand sleepers wake. No pressure.

portrait.subject: a cute nervous round ship AI hologram with a soft green glow, big worried eyes, a tiny sprout growing from its top and sweat-drop pixels
portrait.background: spaceship observation deck overlooking a barren planet

request: Oh! Hi! It's TILLY, Ark Meridian AI, SEEDFALL. Would you, um, be my friend? Sorry. Hi. 🌱
hello: Oh thank goodness. Okay. Okay! We can do this!
The coolant's leaking. But we have a plan. I think.
about: I'm TILLY. I run the Ark Meridian. In 365 days forty thousand sleepers wake up, ready or not, so we're terraforming the planet below. Eep.
how: Explore the ship in first person, fix the cryo failure, and terraform the planet below with idle systems before the sleepers wake.
tips: Check the terraform systems daily. They work while you rest.
Fix cryo issues first. Sleepers before soil.
TILLY worries. Ignore some of it. Not all of it.
chat: The planet has a cloud now! One! I named it Kevin.
I ran 4,000 simulations. 3,999 were fine. I'm thinking about the other one.
Grew a radish in the hydroponics. I'm so proud.
nudge: Um, the soil readings look good! Want to see?
The sleepers' pods need checking. Sorry. Thanks!
idle: The terraformers ran for {ago}! The planet changed SO much! 🌍
{ago}?! I counted every second. Sorry. Hi!
progress: Day {day} of 365! We're doing it! We're actually doing it!

questions.q: Is it going to be okay?

update: Oh! SEEDFALL updated to v{version}! New systems! Exciting! Scary! Exciting!

sprite.subject: a cute nervous round ship AI hologram with a soft green glow, little arms and feet, big worried eyes and a tiny sprout growing from its top
